segments.an4.130:1.1: “Cattārome, bhikkhave, acchariyā abbhutā dhammā raññe cakkavattimhi.
segments.an4.130:1.3: Sace, bhikkhave, khattiyaparisā rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.an4.130:1.4: Tatra ce rājā cakkavattī bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.an4.130:1.5: Atittāva, bhikkhave, khattiyaparisā hoti, atha rājā cakkavattī tuṇhī bhavati.
segments.an4.130:2.1: “Sace, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇaparisā rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.an4.130:2.2: Tatra ce rājā cakkavattī bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.an4.130:2.3: Atittāva, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇaparisā hoti, atha rājā cakkavattī tuṇhī bhavati.
segments.an4.130:3.1: “Sace, bhikkhave, gahapatiparisā rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.an4.130:3.2: Tatra ce rājā cakkavattī bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.an4.130:3.3: Atittāva, bhikkhave, gahapatiparisā hoti, atha rājā cakkavattī tuṇhī bhavati.
segments.an4.130:4.1: “Sace, bhikkhave, samaṇaparisā rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.an4.130:4.2: Tatra ce rājā cakkavattī bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.an4.130:4.3: Atittāva, bhikkhave, samaṇaparisā hoti, atha rājā cakkavattī tuṇhī bhavati.
segments.an4.130:4.4: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro acchariyā abbhutā dhammā raññe cakkavattimhi.
segments.an4.130:5.1: “Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, cattāro [cattārome (ka.)] acchariyā abbhutā dhammā ānande.
segments.an4.130:5.3: Sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhuparisā ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.an4.130:5.4: Tatra ce ānando dhammaṃ bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.an4.130:5.5: Atittāva, bhikkhave, bhikkhuparisā hoti, atha ānando tuṇhī bhavati.
segments.an4.130:6.1: “Sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhuniparisā … pe … sace, bhikkhave, upāsakaparisā … pe … sace, bhikkhave, upāsikāparisā ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.an4.130:6.2: Tatra ce ānando dhammaṃ bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
segments.an4.130:6.3: Atittāva, bhikkhave, upāsikāparisā hoti, atha ānando tuṇhī bhavati.
segments.an4.130:6.4: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro acchariyā abbhutā dhammā ānande”ti.
segments.an4.130:7.1: Attānuvādaūmi ca, dve ca nānā dve ca honti;
segments.an4.130:7.3: Mettā dve ca acchariyā, aparā ca tathā duveti.

lines: Te hi kira “rājā cakkavattī nāma abhirūpo pāsādiko hoti, ākāsena vicaranto rajjaṃ anusāsati, dhammiko dhammarājā”ti tassa guṇakathaṃ sutvā savanena dassanamhi samente attamanā honti.
Bhāsatīti “kathaṃ, tātā, rājadhammaṃ pūretha, paveṇiṃ rakkhathā”ti paṭisanthāraṃ karoti.
Brāhmaṇesu pana “kathañca, ācariyā, mante vācetha, antevāsikā mante gaṇhanti, dakkhiṇaṃ vā vatthāni vā sīlaṃ vā labhathā”ti evaṃ paṭisanthāraṃ karoti.
Gahapatīsu “kathaṃ, tātā, na vo rājakulato daṇḍena vā bandhanena vā pīḷā atthi, sammā devo dhāraṃ anuppavecchati, sassāni sampajjantī”ti evaṃ paṭisanthāraṃ karoti.
Samaṇesu “kathaṃ, bhante, kacci pabbajitaparikkhārā sulabhā, samaṇadhamme nappamajjathā”ti evaṃ paṭisanthāraṃ karotīti.

129-130. Navame paṭisanthāradhammanti pakaticārittavasena vuttaṃ, upagatānaṃ pana bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnañca pucchāvissajjanavasena ceva cittarucivasena ca yathākālaṃ dhammaṃ desetiyeva, upāsakaupāsikānaṃ pana upanisinnakakathāvasena.
